newsitem.title: USA: CME plans to change expiration on rand products.
newsitem.headline: CME plans to change expiration on rand products.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange said it plans to list monthly South African rand futures and options on futures, instead of quarterly contracts.
Pending U.S. regulatory approval, the changes will be implemented June 30 in both pit trade and GLOBEX.
CME said it is de-listing as of June 19 its current South African options on futures until the changes are approved by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
According to the exchange, there is currently no open interest in South African rand options on futures.
The South African products have been trading at the CME since May 7. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
